sections.title: ① 全基因組 v4.1 數據(對抗再驗證後)
sections.html:
v4.1 全基因組（TP 30077/FP 4659, RNULL=40 K=5, elapsed 3762s）vs v3.1 vs 4-gate「30%」

指標v3.1v4.1判定
有結構(≥2群)24.3%23.83%✅ coarse modal 穩定不漂移
├ aligned cis-ASM19.98%19.59% (FP 15.15%)✅ TP 偏多 1.29×
└ unaligned subclone候選4.32%4.24% (FP 8.24%)🔴 FP 0.51×偏多=非subclone
fine_multi(候選更細)—5.29%低信心候選
other 殘群—TP 13.97%FP 26.62% 更多=噪音
unstable(真分裂modal<0.7)—5.61%誠實標 ambiguous
hidden_het—TP 0.52%FP 2.38% 4.6×=噪音

結論: v4.1 確認 v3.1 結論完整不變(structure 23.8%/aligned 19.6%偏TP/unaligned 4.2%偏FP非subclone) + 新層合理 + FP更噪音(other/hidden_het偏多)。對抗再驗證 5 必修: #1modal #3merge-back/warn #4標籤 #2全基因組(此) 全PASS; #5 C++ RNG harness 留cpp-change驗收。
